subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should the plugin SDK permanently expose descriptor-granted mutation and chat-navigation capabilities, and what server-owned context contract should those actions receive?
rationale: This is a new cross-plugin security and SDK contract; resolving the immediate trust defect does not by itself decide the permanent public capability shape.

options.title: Confirm the narrow contract and repair trust
options.body: Retain explicit descriptor allowlists and optional navigation, but derive context-window data at the Gateway and require focused compatibility and live proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the new capability surface
options.body: Defer mutation/navigation bridging until feature owners define a broader plugin UI capability model and migration expectations.

recommendation.title: Confirm the narrow contract and repair trust
recommendation.body: Retain explicit descriptor allowlists and optional navigation, but derive context-window data at the Gateway and require focused compatibility and live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the adjacent sandboxed gateway-auth tab boundary this PR extends.
